name: Zürich Horn Playground
desc: A spectacular adventure playground located directly on the shores of Lake Zürich. Features large wooden climbing structures, slides, rope bridges, a water play area with dams (great for warm days), swings, and plenty of space for parents to relax on the grass.

name: FIFA Museum - Kids Game Zone
desc: An indoor interactive playground located inside the FIFA Museum. Features physical football simulator games, arcade style panels, giant pinball, drawing stations, and physical skill-testing areas. Perfect for rainy days in Zürich.

name: Alpamare Indoor Water Park
desc: Europe's largest covered water park. Features 12 water slides (totaling 2.1km of sliding fun!), indoor and outdoor pools, wave pool, toddler splash paddling zone with mini slides, and beautiful views of Lake Zurich.

name: Gurten Playground & Toboggan
desc: Situated on Bern's home mountain, Gurten. An enormous playground featuring a miniature train system, climbing grids, giant wood slides, water streams for splashing, a kids car driving circuit, and a spectacular summer toboggan run.

name: Bernaqua Water Park & Wave Pool
desc: A huge, futuristic indoor water park in Bern Westside. Offers a jungle wave pool, three large indoor slides with lights and sound, a wild river stream pool, and a dedicated, warm baby pool with interactive toys.

name: Parc des Bastions Playground
desc: A historic park in the heart of Geneva. Features a shaded kids' playground with sand pits, climbing towers, and wooden structures, plus giant chess sets that kids love. Fenced area makes it easy to monitor toddlers.

name: Yatouland Indoor Fun Park
desc: A large indoor leisure arena in Geneva designed for kids. Features multiple bouncy castles, giant inflatables, a soft play obstacle course, a laser tag arena, and a mini trampoline section. Excellent for active energy burn.

name: Park im Grünen & Dinosaur Park
desc: A huge park near Basel featuring a fantastic wooden adventure playground, life-sized static dinosaur figures, a miniature lake with ducks, carousel rides, and a mini golf course. Extremely family-friendly with large picnic lawns.

name: Aquabasilea Splash Pool
desc: A premier water park in the Basel area. Includes a rapid outdoor river torrent, several high-thrill slides, an indoor wave pool, and a kids water village area equipped with spray nozzles, buckets, and low slides.

name: Lido Luzern Beach & Pool
desc: A gorgeous lake beach resort on Lake Lucerne. Offers a 250-meter long sandy beach, a large heated outdoor kids pool with fountains, water toys, an adventure playground, and vast grassy lawns for sunbathing.
fees: 7 CHF for Adults, 3 CHF for Kids

name: Swiss Transport Museum Roadwork Zone
desc: An interactive, educational kid zone inside the museum. Children can drive miniature dump trucks, operate diggers, load soft bricks, and build roads wearing high-visibility vests. A wonderful tactile experience.

name: Signal de Bougy Park
desc: A huge, free-access recreational park overlooking Lake Geneva. Contains large wooden play castles, ziplines, swings, a petting zoo with goats and pigs, a mini-golf course, and an amphitheater with kids' performances.

name: Splash & Spa Tamaro
desc: A tropical-themed indoor water park in Ticino. Boasts a massive kids' splash paradise under glass domes, multiple wave generators, low-hazard spray parks, and slide networks. Heated year-round to 34°C.

name: Lido di Lugano Swimming Pool
desc: Classic outdoor resort featuring an Olympic pool, diving towers, a dedicated heated kids' pool with mini-fountains and a slide, plus a grass playground area right next to the lake.
fees: 8 CHF for Adults, 4 CHF for Kids

name: St. Gallen Wildlife & Playpark Peter & Paul
desc: A nature-themed forest park. Features a lovely woodland kids playground, walkable pathways where children can spot ibexes, deer, marmots, and wild boars. Very peaceful and educational.

name: Allmendhubel Flower Park
desc: One of the most iconic alpine playgrounds in Switzerland, featuring a water labyrinth, flower trail, wood zip line, climbing frames, and wooden alpine cows, all with the Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau peaks as a backdrop.

name: Mooraculum Nature Playpark
desc: A massive nature adventure park focused on moorland ecosystems. Contains obstacle courses, suspended wooden walkways, a water play station with rafts, sound games, and a educational trail for curious minds.

name: Wolli's Adventure Park at Sunnegga
desc: Located next to the scenic Leisee lake, this playground features wooden play boats, a water raft that kids can pull across the lake, climbing frames, slides, and sand pits with a direct view of the Matterhorn.

name: Bort Alpine Playground Grindelwald
desc: Nesting on Grindelwald-First slopes, this playground covers 700m2 with slides, balancing beams, climbing ropes, trampolines, and stream beds for water games, all with views of the Eiger north face.

name: Kiddy Dome Indoor Adventure Park
desc: One of Switzerland's largest indoor playgrounds. Features multi-level climbing labyrinths, vertical drop slides, donut-glider tracks, interactive play zones, jumping trampolines, and a dedicated toddler soft play section.

name: Trampolino Indoor Funpark
desc: Known as the largest children's indoor playground in Switzerland. Packed with high-thrill trampolines, a giant climbing volcano, climbing walls, a mini ferris wheel, indoor go-karts, and a massive soft maze.

name: Spiez Indoor Funpark
desc: An indoor play paradise with over 2000m² of space. Features bouncy castles, soft obstacles, climbing networks, table football, air hockey, and safe baby zones for the smallest kids.

name: Urba Kids Indoor Adventure
desc: A multi-level indoor play center located in Orbe. Boasts colorful bouncy castles, soft ball pools, electric mini-karts, rope slides, and interactive games. Organizes treasure hunts during winter.

name: Leukerbad Therme Family Zone
desc: The largest thermal baths alpine resort in Europe. Incorporates warm indoor and outdoor pools, two giant high-speed loop slides, and a dedicated kids splash paradise filled with water cannons and nozzles.

name: Baar Lättich Indoor & Outdoor Pool
desc: A comprehensive family pool facility. Offers a 105-meter giant water slide, an indoor lazy river, heated wellness pools, kids' splash play yards, and massive outdoor swimming bays during the summer season.

name: MFO Park Climbing Pergola
desc: An architectural marvel in Zurich. The entire structure is a giant steel double-walled framework covered in green vines. Features integrated climbing stairs, skywalks, and lookouts that older kids love to climb and explore.

name: Irchelpark Nature Play Spaces
desc: A beautifully designed natural park in Zurich. Features vast green slopes, wide paved walking tracks, small wooden bridges over natural streams, duck ponds, and gravel playing zones ideal for outdoor active play.

name: Strandbad Zug Kids Beach & Pool
desc: A family-favorite lakeside beach on Lake Zug. Offers a flat, gently sloping sandy beach, a shaded baby paddling pool, a water trampoline, and a lovely kids playground on the lawns.
fees: 4 CHF for adults, 2 CHF for kids

name: Marzili Outdoor Swimming Pools
desc: Bern's famous riverside swimming spot. Provides huge, free-access grassy lawns, multiple children wading pools with fountains and animal sprinklers, a 50m lap pool, and a giant water slide.

name: Play Village Zurich
desc: A premium, beautifully crafted indoor play space where children engage in role-playing. Features miniature towns with a post office, supermarket, veterinarian clinic, and kitchen, letting kids imagine and play.

name: Schluefweg Swimming Complex Kloten
desc: A fantastic swimming complex for the whole family in Kloten. Features a spectacular outdoor pool with a giant 'rocket ship' water slide, kids splash paddling zone under sun protection, a 5m diving tower, and a year-round indoor pool with a warm 30°C non-swimmer area.

name: Entdeckerspielplatz Egetswil
desc: An outdoor adventure discovery playground in Egetswil, Kloten. Features wood-built climbing units, balance beams, swings, a water-stream play system with dams, and dedicated fireplace/grill installations for family BBQs.

name: Seilpark Zürich (Forest Ropes Course)
desc: An outdoor high ropes adventure course located in the forest next to Zentrum Schluefweg. Features 11 challenging trails of varying heights and difficulty, including kid-friendly trails with continuous safety belays. A perfect active family day out.

name: Stadtpark Playground Kloten
desc: A modern public playground located in the heart of Kloten Stadtpark near the Altbach stream. Offers custom wooden climbing towers, multi-lane slides, swings, and sandboxes in a nicely shaded green environment.

name: Zurichhorn Park & Playground
desc: Beloved lakeside park with splash areas, picnic meadows, and great views of Lake Zurich. Free entry, perfect for all ages.

name: Bellerivepark
desc: Charming lakefront park with water play features, swings, and open green spaces for children to run free.

name: Elfenau Park
desc: One of Bern's most beautiful playgrounds set in trees and meadows, with water features, slides, a wooden fort, sandbox, and swings.

name: St. Johanns Park
desc: Well-equipped family park with play facilities, clean toilets, lockers, nursing room, and a splash pool for little ones.

name: Parc La Grange
desc: Geneva's most popular family park with a rose garden, large playground, open lawns by Lake Geneva, and seasonal water jets.

name: Bois de la Bâtie
desc: Popular woodland park with a small zoo, adventure playground, mini train, and mini-golf — a full day out for families.

name: Parc de Sauvabelin
desc: Enchanting forest park with a deer enclosure, lake, wooden tower, and nature playground — magical for children year-round.

name: Inseli Park
desc: Scenic lakeside park in central Lucerne with a great playground, paddleboat rentals nearby, and breathtaking mountain views.

name: Zugersee Lakeside Park
desc: Gorgeous lake park with a children's playground, paddling area, seasonal beach, and views of the Alps across Lake Zug.

name: Stadtpark St. Gallen
desc: Central city park with a large playground, pond, wooded pathways, and open lawns great for family picnics.

name: Stoos Alpine Playground
desc: Spectacular car-free alpine village with a fenced adventure playground at 1300m altitude, with stunning lake and mountain views.

name: Alpamare Water Park
desc: Switzerland's largest water park! 12 slides spanning 2.1 km, children's paradise, wave pool, and wellness. 30 min from Zurich by train.

name: Dolder Bad
desc: Historic lido in leafy grounds above Zurich. 50m outdoor pool, shaded paddling pool, and play area surrounded by forest.

name: Bernaqua Adventure Pool
desc: The largest adventure pool in Canton Bern — 2,000 m² of water, three giant slides, white-water canyon, and 18 different pools.

name: Marzili Freibad
desc: Among Switzerland's oldest baths, right in the shadow of the Parliament. Free entry, river swim on the Aare, massively popular in summer.

name: Weyermannshaus Freibad
desc: Switzerland's largest outdoor pool by water surface — 16,000 m² across multiple pools with waterslides and a children's area.

name: Genève-Plage
desc: Iconic lakeside lido on Lake Geneva with an Olympic pool, beach area, water slides, and stunning views of Mont Blanc.

name: Piscine de Bellerive
desc: Outdoor lakeside pool complex with a 50m competition pool, children's pool, grass sunbathing areas, and Lake Geneva access.

name: Lido Lucerne
desc: Beautiful outdoor pool and beach on Lake Lucerne with mountain backdrop. Lakeside swimming, pools for all ages, and a stunning Alpine setting.

name: Lido di Lugano
desc: Mediterranean-feel lido in Ticino with lake swimming, waterslides, sandy beach area, and palm trees — a taste of the Italian south.

name: Flip Lab Zurich
desc: Massive 3,000 m² trampoline park near Zurich airport with jump zones, dodge ball, foam pit, parkour, and trained instructors.

name: Play Village Zürich
desc: Creative indoor play world with themed rooms — supermarket, café, construction site, medical centre. Book a 2-hour slot. Ages 1–8.

name: The Jump Spot Lausanne
desc: Switzerland's biggest indoor trampoline park — 150 trampolines across 3,300 m²! Foam pits, slam dunk zones, dodgeball, and ninja course.

name: Jump Factory Basel
desc: Huge trampoline park with basketball trampolines, foam pit, free jump areas, and dodgeball court — great for all ages.

name: Kids Arena Lucerne
desc: Lucerne's largest indoor playground for ages 0–10. Climbing wall, ball pit, electric go-kart track, trampolines, and a soft-play toddler zone.

name: Freiruum Spielruum — Zug
desc: Indoor playground for children aged 2–7 inside the Freiruum complex, plus a 120 m² trampoline park. Café on site.

name: Elevation Indoor Winterthur
desc: Creative indoor playground in Winterthur's Lagerplatz district — bouncy castles, swirly slides, trampolines, and a ball pit.

name: Kindercity Bern
desc: Interactive children's city where kids role-play as doctors, firefighters, chefs, and more in themed rooms for imaginative play.

name: X-Stream Trampoline Park
desc: High-energy trampoline park east of Zurich with a ninja warrior course, slam dunk zones, foam pits, and dedicated toddler sections.

name: Grosser Moorrundweg Gewinnspiel
desc: Gondola to Rossweid, Mooraculum playground, Moorrundweg hiking, Forscherbox, restaurant
fees: Family Package CHF 94 (gondola + rodelbahn + Forscherbox); Kinder bis 8 Jahre kostenlos

desc: Bears, wolves, lynxes, deer, boars; playgrounds, BBQ, Restaurant Langenberg; stroller-friendly

name: Freizeitpark wird völlig unterschätzt

fees: Ages 6+: 1hr CHF 18, all-day CHF 42; Ages 1–2: CHF 8/hr; Kiddies (under 6): CHF 12

desc: Family café with indoor play zones for toddlers and older kids, café menu

desc: Large outdoor labyrinth & adventure park in Valais

desc: Farm animals, farm shop, seasonal displays, playground
fees: FREE (bring CHF 2 for wooden ball; budget for farm shop)

desc: Lakeside playground on Lake Constance promenade

desc: 45-min chocolate Easter bunny workshop with treats

fees: Adults CHF 19; Children (2+) CHF 17 (cash only); Dino ride FREE
